Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC: – List of documents to be upload during the bid submission:- 1. An undertaking / Authorization for this bid from major OEM (Tadiran) along wit h bid documents specifying that. a) The OEM shall technically support the firm through out the period of c ontract. b) The OEM shall provide all spare parts for healthy functioning of syste m, service support, software upgrade etc, throughout the period of con tract. 2. Past experience criteria: - The bidders who have satisfactorily completed the similar nature works as mentioned below during the last three years ending last day of month previous to the one in which tenders are invited: i) Three similar works each costing not less than the amount equal t o 40% of estimated cost of the work. or ii) Two similar works each costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of estimated cost of the work. or iii) One similar completed work of aggregated cost not less than am ount equal to 80% of estimated cost of the work. Similar work shall mean works of “IP-BAX SYSTEM ”. 3. Valid Electrical License. The contractors will be allowed to participate in tender with an undertakin g that they will either obtain valid electrical license at the time of executio n of electrical work or associate contractors having valid electrical license of eligible class where ever required. 4. Valid GST registration certificate and upto date return uploaded. 5. Scanned copy of EMD. EMD in the form of DD/Banker’s Cheque/FDR in favour of ‘Executive Engineer (E), B-241, PWD, New Delhi-110002’ (to be deposited in Delhi)

6. Receipt of deposition of original EMD. 7. Bidder financial standing- The bidder should not be under liquidation, court rec eivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. 8. Service & Support- Office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. 9. Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Escalation Matrix for Service Support 11. Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For 3 Years)- 73 Lacs . 16. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 17. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 2 Years Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 2 Years usable shelf life should be available / balance. 18. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under.
